ruff format --check .  # 54 files already formatted, exit 0
mypy bot  # Success: no issues found in 29 source files, exit 0

acceptance.item: On a clean clone: `pip install -e ".[dev]"`, `pytest -q` and `ruff check .` all pass.
acceptance.note: Fresh clone of 903968d; venv + pip install -e ".[dev]" ok; pytest -q → 157 passed in 3.52s; ruff check . → All checks passed. Also ruff format --check and mypy bot clean.

acceptance.item: With a valid BOT_TOKEN the bot starts via `python -m bot`; /start replies with a Russian greeting and usage instructions; /help lists supported platforms.
acceptance.note: No BOT_TOKEN in environment or .env. Could not start the bot or exercise /start /help live. Unit/integration cover /start and /help text with mocked Bot.

acceptance.item: Sending a public YouTube link produces, within 5 seconds, a card with inline buttons: at least one quality option, an audio option and a cancel button.
acceptance.note: Not executed live. Handler/integration tests mock extractor and assert keyboard contents; no real Telegram round-trip.

acceptance.item: Pressing a quality button delivers the video as a Telegram video message that plays inline (public YouTube video under 50 MB).
acceptance.note: Not executed live. Review paths for thumbnails/send_video covered by unit tests only; needs BOT_TOKEN + real download.

acceptance.item: A YouTube Shorts link works exactly like a regular YouTube link.
acceptance.note: Detector/unit coverage for Shorts URLs exists; live Shorts download not run.

acceptance.item: A TikTok link delivers the video, without watermark when such a format is available.
acceptance.note: Not executed live. Review-1 TikTok ranking tests use real-shaped yt-dlp fixtures; live no-watermark delivery unverified.

acceptance.item: A public Instagram Reels link delivers the video; if Instagram blocks extraction without cookies, the bot replies with a clear message about configuring IG_COOKIES_FILE instead of crashing.
acceptance.note: IG cookies / auth-error i18n covered in unit tests; live Reel extract not run (no token, and often needs cookies).

acceptance.item: The audio button delivers an mp3 as a Telegram audio message with title and performer filled.
acceptance.note: Not executed live. Sender unit tests assert title/performer; needs BOT_TOKEN + ffmpeg path on a real callback.

acceptance.item: For a video whose chosen quality exceeds 50 MB the bot explains the limit and offers smaller qualities; no exception is raised.
acceptance.note: Verified via integration/dispatcher tests for the oversize path (FileTooLarge → explain + smaller qualities). Not a live Telegram press.

acceptance.item: An unsupported or malformed link yields a friendly message; no traceback is sent or logged as unhandled.
acceptance.note: Integration + break tests: unsupported (e.g. vimeo) and malformed/non-URL inputs yield friendly handling; classify_url returns None for bad shapes.

acceptance.item: The progress message is updated while downloading and is replaced by the result card with a 'another format' button.
acceptance.note: Not executed live. Progress/result-card guards covered in unit/regression tests only.

acceptance.item: Requesting the same URL and format a second time is answered instantly from the file_id cache (no re-download, verified via logs or timing).
acceptance.note: Integration cache-hit test stores file_id under resolved identity and asserts resend without download. Live timing not measured.

acceptance.item: Exceeding RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN yields a polite refusal that states the wait time.
acceptance.note: Dispatcher-level integration test confirms RateLimitMiddleware fires on Update unwrap and returns wait-time refusal.

acceptance.item: /settings allows changing the default quality and the language; after switching to English all bot replies are in English.
acceptance.note: Integration test covers ru→en switch and settings callbacks with mocked Bot. Live /settings UI not exercised.

acceptance.item: `docker compose up -d --build` starts the bot and the container healthcheck becomes healthy.
acceptance.note: docker and docker compose are not installed on the test box. Dockerfile/compose/healthcheck present; non-root USER change not run against a daemon.

findings.title: Live Telegram acceptance blocked: no BOT_TOKEN
findings.details: Acceptance items 2–8 and 11 require a running bot with a valid BOT_TOKEN and a Telegram account to message it. Environment has neither BOT_TOKEN nor .env. Offline suite is green (157 tests).
reproduction: Cannot run python -m bot or scripts/e2e_smoke.py against Telegram

findings.title: Docker acceptance not runnable on test box
findings.details: docker / docker compose binaries missing; acceptance item 15 unverified. Image healthcheck definition was inspected only.

findings.title: Test host uses Python 3.13.5 while spec targets 3.12
findings.details: Suite passed on 3.13.5; Dockerfile still uses python:3.12-slim. No failure observed, but runtime differs from the documented stack.

summary: Offline gates green on 903968d: 157 pytest, ruff check/format, mypy bot. Acceptance 1,9,10,12,13,14 met via suite/integration. Items 2–8,11 blocked on missing BOT_TOKEN; item 15 blocked on missing Docker. Report under .grokflow/reports/test-4.json for orchestrator poll.
